courses.title: Energy Healing & Insight Sessions
courses.description: Her main one-to-one work: a session that begins with a conversation about your intentions, moves into hands-on or distance energy healing while you rest, and ends with sharing the intuitive insights that came up. First sessions run 90 minutes, in person or on Zoom.

flags: Her home page lists relieving physical or emotional pain and sleeping easily among the benefits, and says blocks may show as ailments that do not respond to traditional treatment; it also says the work goes with medical therapy and is not a substitute for it. Kept under the new rule (no disease named, no advice to replace care); the description repeats none of it.
Prices are from her Gift / Purchase page (pravahahealing.com/gift-certificates).
